title: Windows
description: Tiled chat windows: several sessions on screen at once, split, resized, moved and focused with keys or the mouse

settings.label: Key prefix
settings.desc: Pressed before each window key (v, s, h, j, k, l, …). Reload the plugin after changing it.

settings.label: Watch sub-agents
settings.desc: Open each new sub-agent's session in a window under its owner's, to watch it work.
